messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: gpu-autoscaler-stuck in private-vpc-nyc (severity: P1). Queue length for gpu-pool-cust42 > 880, token latency spiking above 6s. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

maria: taking pager — assigning to me. seeing a steady inflight queue, throttle errors from the scaler. tagging @eng-infra and @ops-backfill.

ajay: on it. first glance: autoscaler is hitting scaleLimit for the customer's cluster (maxNodes=8) but nodes are stuck in Provisioning state for ~8m each. provisioning retries backoff is preventing new attempts.

samantha: customer impact: cust42 reports slow responses for inference jobs and some timeouts. their SLA calls out 99th latency — looks like lots of reruns. CS (lisa-cs) has a support ticket open and wants an ETA to tell the customer.

maria: quick triage notes — kube events show node bootstrap failing at our init-hook: "preflight-check: ami-signature-mismatch". that hook was added last month as a hard gate for private clusters for security. looks like cust42 recently updated their AMI and the signature didn't land in our registry. autoscaler refuses to finish node join.

eng-infra: confirmed. excerpt from node-init logs:

```
2026-03-14T18:42:05Z systemd[1]: Starting redwood-node-init.service...
2026-03-14T18:42:12Z node-init[2381]: running preflight checks
2026-03-14T18:42:12Z node-init[2381]: checking AMI signature against registry
2026-03-14T18:42:12Z node-init[2381]: ERROR: ami signature not found for ami-0c9f7ab2
2026-03-14T18:42:12Z node-init[2381]: aborting node join
```

eng-infra: the autoscaler marks node attempt failed and moves to exponential backoff. with concurrent provisioning failures, effective node throughput is ~0.5 nodes/hour.

tom: is there any safe bypass we can flip to allow nodes to join while we reconciliate the signature? we need immediate capacity.

maria: options — (1) temporarily disable the preflight AMI signature gate for cust42 cluster (risky but fastest), (2) manually create nodes from a verified AMI and attach them to the pool (requires cloud perms), (3) increase maxNodes as a short-term buffer if there are warm nodes available elsewhere — but for private clusters we don't have spare fleet.

ops-backfill: I can manually launch 3 nodes with a verified AMI and attach. takes ~12m to boot and join if networking is healthy.

lisa-cs: please confirm before doing anything that could change customer nodes. I can push an immediate note to cust42: "we're investigating provisioning failures and may create temporary nodes to restore throughput — we'll update in 15m".

ajay: eng-infra — can you try a targeted fix: accept the incoming AMI signature for that AMI hash as transient (audit logged) so node-init passes? That would unblock autoscaler without spinning manual machines.

eng-infra: we can add a temporary signature allowlist entry for ami-0c9f7ab2 scoped to cluster cust42, audit logged and auto-revoked in 4h. requires console write. I can patch now but will need a second for approval.

maria: approved. do it. log change and notify. ops-backfill stand by but hold manual launches for now.

eng-infra: patch applied. consistency check shows node-init now passing signature check. starting to see more successful node joins. autoscaler backoff remains but new attempts succeed now.

incident-bot: update: 3 new nodes joined pool gpu-pool-cust42, total nodes now 6/8. inflight queue dropping from 880 -> 320 in last 10m. average per-token latency fell 30%.

ajay: good. still seeing a backlog of long-running requests; we should consider a short-term routing policy to favor critical customer jobs and deprioritize non-urgent batch to recover tail latency.

maria: implemented temporary QoS route: reduce concurrency for batch-runner by 50% and divert excess to hosted-fallback model (redwood-small) for non-SLA traffic. put a label on impacted customer jobs so CS can distinguish.

lisa-cs: sent update to cust42: "We've temporarily allowed your new AMI to join the cluster under a signed audit and launched additional capacity. You may see reduced latency within 15–20 minutes. We will follow up with a permanent fix and a postmortem." customer acknowledged and asked for estimated time to full recovery.

eng-infra: autoscaler backoff counters are still non-zero; scheduling rate now ~2 nodes/10m. with current joins we should get to steady state ~30m.

ops-backfill: manual launch still ready if we see new failures. also recommending a follow-up: add a warm-spare policy to private clusters for critical customers so we can avoid hitting scale limits when AMI changes happen.

maria: agreed. action items captured:
- eng-infra: roll permanent fix — ensure AMI signature distribution pipeline to customer's AMI pushes within 5m of their AMI change; add test that detects signature drift. (owner: eng-infra, ETA 2d)
- infra/ops: implement warm-spare pool option for private clusters (owner: ops-backfill + eng-infra, ETA 1w)
- product: document emergency bypass process and add guardrails for audit + auto-revoke (owner: product, ETA 3d)
- cs: follow up with cust42 with RCA and timeline (owner: lisa-cs, ETA 24h)

maria: current status: severity downgraded to P2. still monitoring until backlog < 50 and 99th latency < 1s. I'll stay on thread until stable. handing off to night oncall @samantha in 40m.

samantha: thanks — I'll monitor and escalate if anything regresses. great job everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident update posted to #postmortems when created. please add notes and logs under incident-4287654321.

maria: closing active pager. leaving follow-up tasks in the incident doc.
